mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT r.group_id FROM rounds r INNER JOIN `groups` g ON g.group_id = r.group_id WHERE g.group_status = 'ONGOING' AND r.round_status = 'WAITING_SETTLEMENT' AND r.end_date = DATE_SUB(#{settlementDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY r.group_id

SELECT round_id, group_id, round_no, start_date, end_date, round_status, created_at FROM rounds WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND round_status = 'WAITING_SETTLEMENT' AND end_date = #{endDate} ORDER BY round_no DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT rh.round_history_id, rh.user_id, rh.account_id, rh.moim_account_id, rh.rank_no, gu.group_user_id, gu.current_deposit_amount, destination.kb_account_id AS destination_kb_account_id, destination_kb.account_number AS destination_account_number, destination_kb.name AS destination_account_name, source.kb_account_id AS source_kb_account_id, source_kb.account_number AS source_account_number, source_kb.name AS source_account_name FROM round_history rh INNER JOIN rounds r ON r.round_id = rh.round_id LEFT JOIN group_users gu ON gu.group_id = r.group_id AND gu.user_id = rh.user_id LEFT JOIN accounts destination ON destination.account_id = rh.account_id AND destination.user_id = rh.user_id LEFT JOIN kb_accounts destination_kb ON destination_kb.kb_account_id = destination.kb_account_id LEFT JOIN moim_accounts source ON source.moim_account_id = rh.moim_account_id LEFT JOIN kb_accounts source_kb ON source_kb.kb_account_id = source.kb_account_id WHERE rh.round_id = #{roundId} ORDER BY gu.group_user_id, rh.round_history_id FOR UPDATE
SELECT balance FROM kb_accounts WHERE kb_account_id = #{kbAccountId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE round_history SET settlement_amount = #{settlementAmount}, prior_failure_response = NULL, settlement_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE round_history_id = #{roundHistoryId} AND settlement_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_transactions ( kb_account_id, group_user_id, round_id, transaction_type, transaction_category, amount, balance_after, idempotency_key, description, another_account_number, another_bank_name, another_name ) VALUES ( #{kbAccountId}, #{groupUserId}, #{roundId}, #{transactionType}, #{transactionCategory}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{description}, #{anotherAccountNumber}, #{anotherBankName}, #{anotherName} )
